title: MISSING.
summary: Mr. Arthur Pell departed from the Alderwick receiving hall on the 14th carrying a folded map and two chronometers. One clock came home. Any information of Mr. Pell, or of the other clock, will be gratefully received by his mother.
author: Agony Column Desk
